title: S5 s5_plate_cleanliness
objective:
BUG: render_text_guard.ensure_text_free() reports cleaned=True as soon as OCR finds zero boxes, even when the clean pass left faint marks below the OCR threshold. A smeared plate ships as clean.
REQUIRED BEHAVIOUR: add a plate-cleanliness measurement to Northstar_backend/render_text_guard.py:
 * module constant RESIDUAL_MARK_THRESHOLD = 0.002 (fraction of the plate's pixels a residual mark may occupy)
 * ensure_text_free(..., measure=None) where measure(png) -> dict with key 'residual_mark_fraction' (float 0..1); when measure is None the default measurement is used (it may return None when no instrument is available, and then cleanliness is 'unavailable' - never a pass).
 * the returned dict gains 'plate_clean' (True/False/None) and 'residuals' (the measure's dict, or a reason).
 * text-free and plate-clean are DIFFERENT facts: a plate with 0 OCR boxes but residual_mark_fraction above RESIDUAL_MARK_THRESHOLD has plate_clean False, keeps cleaned True (text was removed), and its reason names the residual marks.
 * below the threshold, plate_clean is True. No detector/measure result must never be reported as clean.
CONSTRAINT: existing keys and behaviour must not change - Northstar_backend/test_render_text_guard.py must stay green.
CHECK: python -m pytest Northstar_backend/test_render_text_guard.py -x -q
